notes: Hebrew speech to text, with voice destination search in Waze. Listed on Ogen Play, whose downloads need a sign in and hand out a signed link that expires after five minutes, so it cannot be a source. The application's own updater names a public repository instead, o054840/hebvoice-updates, and its latest release asset (HebrewVoice-v3.9.2.apk, versionCode 25) is byte for byte the Ogen Play file: sha256 55981e59...6253 on both, and the same value in the repository's update.json. Signed with the developer's own key (CN=HebrewVoice, O=Private, C=IL). The in-app updater installs from the same repository, and only a build signed with this key can update it in place.
